_comment: A lone block of 96 Spearmen (6 files of 16) facing west, doubled to 12 files of 8 by a plain explicatio (B, the half-file drill) and then folded back by N after Alt+N has chosen the face-about reading of the duplicatio that undoes it (DuplicatioMarch.FACE_ABOUT). Asclepiodotus 10.20 and Aelian 29.3 say the men who went up the intervals countermarch back to their original stations, and a countermarch turns the men about (Asclepiodotus 10.13 to 10.15). Each of the 48 men of the six intervals faces about where he stands, turning through his own facing at the drill turn rate, marches back down his interval with its rear man leading, steps in behind the man he will follow, and faces front again on his station; the front rank keeps its line at x 652.5. Drill mode, no enemy. By tick 600 the explicatio has ended with the block at (684.03, 420.0); Alt+N at tick 640 chooses the reading and N at tick 660 deals the files back. From tick 680 to 840 all 48 men of the intervals face about; each column's rear man reaches his station first, by tick 840, and the men face front again on their stations from the rear forward, until by tick 1200 every man faces front with the block at (720.03, 420.0), its front at x 652.53. Facing their way, they are back sooner than the walk: at tick 900 this block stands at x 712.14 where the walk's stands at 700.59. No two men come within a body radius, and no paths or files cross. Measured 2026-11-14 on FULL dumps on seed runs 0 to 4 (no enemy, no roll). On main, Alt+N is no choice: the men walk back facing front, so men_facing_about reads 0 and the position at tick 900 fails. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s).
